notes: Searches: both used, on In the Eyes of Grieving Mothers and on the Oak Lane Friends group. The other IRS groups with no web address (Damirs, Entrepreneurs of America, Esthercares, Future Path, House of Wisdom-Chrida) got no search, so they are held as unknown with no summary. Generations Restored has a dead domain and is also held. Friends 4 Life is held as out_of_area for review because its current address is outside Philadelphia. Hands Elevated publishes its events-page dates, which come from link addresses. Every IRS address that is a home or apartment, or that the site does not show, is left out. The Free Library pages returned 403, so the Oak Lane Friends record stays held until verified. No rate limiting was seen on other domains. Records with status unknown and no summary are held back by design. Ran out of search budget before finishing the no-address IRS groups; this is the main gap.

records.name: Friends of the Oak Lane Library
records.notes: IRS list name is Friends of the Free Library of Philadelphia Inc, at 6614 N 12th St, which is the Oak Lane Library address. Search results (snippets only, not pages I could open) describe a separate 501(c)(3) called Friends of the Oak Lane Library that meets monthly and welcomes adults. The Free Library calendar page and the Oak Lane branch page both returned HTTP 403 to my fetch, so nothing from them is recorded. The IRS EIN is not confirmed as this group's. The search snippet also listed an email address that was not verified on a readable page. Verify on a readable page before publishing. No summary is written.
